newsitem.title: USA: Union Planters to acquire Sho-Me.
newsitem.headline: Union Planters to acquire Sho-Me.

text.p: Union Planters Corp said it has a definitive agreement to acquire Sho-Me Financial Corp for about $59 million in stock.

Under the deal, Union Planters is to exchange 0.7964 shares of its common stock for each common share of Sho-Me. Union Planters said it plans to purchase about 1.2 million shares in the open market to use in the exchange.
The transaction is expected to completed by the fourth quarter of 1997.
Sho-Me, which is based in Mt. Vernon, Mo., operates eight banks under the name 1st Savings Bank. Union Planters is a multi-bank holdig company.
